records.issue_text: | P1 | packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts:47 | Combining the mutually exclusive admin and owner checks with && denies both team admins and owners access to team bookings. | correctness | 0.97 |
records.rationale: The diff shows `const isTeamAdminOrOwner = (await isTeamAdmin(user.id, ...)) && (await isTeamOwner(user.id, ...));` which requires the user to be BOTH admin and owner. A team admin who is not the owner (or owner-only edge cases) fails the check, so despite the variable name 'isTeamAdminOrOwner' it denies most admins/owners, and combined with `!isTeamAdminOrOwner && !isOrganizer && !isAttendee` throws FORBIDDEN. The logic operator should be ||. This is a clear correctness defect verifiable directly from the diff.
